description: Ba₄Na₂W₂O₁₁ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Amm2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent WO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-3°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.42 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra and corners with three equivalent WO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 10°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.62 Å. Ba is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.69-3.24 Å. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to five O atoms to form WO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with three equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 7°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-1.94 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-3°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-1.99 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, four equivalent Ba, and one W atom to form distorted OBa₄NaW octahedra that share corners with six OBa₄NaW octahedra, corners with four equivalent OBa₂NaW trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent OBa₄NaW octahedra, and faces with six OBa₄NaW octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-54°. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, four equivalent Ba, and one W atom to form distorted OBa₄NaW octahedra that share corners with six OBa₄NaW octahedra, corners with four equivalent OBa₂NaW trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent OBa₄NaW octahedra, and faces with six OBa₄NaW octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-56°. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, four equivalent Ba, and one W atom to form distorted OBa₄NaW octahedra that share corners with six OBa₄NaW octahedra, corners with four equivalent OBa₂NaW trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent OBa₄NaW octahedra, and faces with six OBa₄NaW octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-55°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na, four equivalent Ba, and one W atom to form distorted OBa₄NaW octahedra that share corners with fourteen OBa₄NaW octahedra, corners with two equivalent OBa₂NaW trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent OBa₂NaW trigonal pyramids, and faces with four OBa₄NaW octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-56°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Na, four equivalent Ba, and one W atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na, four equivalent Ba, and one W atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Ba, and one W atom to form distorted OBa₂NaW trigonal pyramids that share corners with ten OBa₄NaW octahedra, corners with two equivalent OBa₂NaW trigonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent OBa₄NaW octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-81°.
